title: Parts of Speech
sub: 先備概念：先認識英文的八種「字的工作」，之後每一課都會用到。The eight word jobs — the map for everything that follows.

form.p: Every word has a job: naming, doing, describing or joining.

uses.d: A noun names a person, place, thing or idea. A pronoun stands in for a noun so we don't repeat it.

ex.n: an idea is a noun too

ex.s: Ben is tired, so he went to bed.

uses.t: Doing & describing words: verbs, adjectives, adverbs
uses.d: A verb shows an action or a state. An adjective describes a noun. An adverb describes a verb (and often ends in -ly).

uses.t: Little joining & pointing words: prepositions, conjunctions, interjections
uses.d: A preposition shows place or time (in, on, under, before). A conjunction joins ideas (and, but, because). An interjection shows sudden feeling (Wow! Oh!).

ex.s: I was tired, but I finished the work.

mistakes.why: To describe a verb (sings) you need an adverb, not an adjective.

mistakes.no: He is a quick runner and runs quick.
mistakes.yes: He is a quick runner and runs quickly.
mistakes.why: quick describes the noun runner; quickly describes the verb runs.
a/an are articles — a small kind of adjective; use an before a vowel sound.

tip: Ask what job the word does: names it (noun), replaces it (pronoun), does it (verb), describes a noun (adjective) or a verb (adverb), or joins/points (preposition, conjunction, interjection). 這一課學會了，後面每一課都更容易。

q.q: In 'Birds sing every morning', which word is the verb?
q.why: sing is the action word → verb.

q.q: In 'The old house is empty', which word is an adjective?
q.why: old describes the noun house → adjective.
It describes the verb sang → adverb.

q.q: Which word is a preposition? 'The ball rolled under the car.'
How many pronouns are in 'They gave it to us'?
'I run daily' and 'I went for a run.' The word 'run' is…
q.why: Same word, different jobs: run (verb) and a run (noun).

q.q: A word that names a person, place, thing or idea is a ___ .
q.why: Nouns name people, places, things and ideas.
They join words or ideas → conjunctions.

q.sent: He drives careful in the rain .
q.why: An adverb describes the verb drives → carefully.

q.sent: That was a real good movie .
q.why: To describe the adjective good, use the adverb really.
tired (adjective) describes children; quietly (adverb) describes slept.

title: Nouns
sub: 人、地、事、物、概念的名稱：普通／專有、具體／抽象、物質、集合、複合名詞，以及可數／不可數與數·性·格。

form.p: A noun names a person, place, thing or idea. （名詞片語 = 限定詞 + 名詞）

uses.t: 普通名詞 & 專有名詞 Common & Proper
uses.d: 普通名詞是「一般」的名稱；專有名詞是「特定」的名稱，第一個字母要大寫。人名、地名、語言、星期、月份都是專有名詞。

uses.t: 具體名詞 & 抽象名詞 Concrete & Abstract
uses.d: 具體名詞看得見、摸得著（apple, rain）；抽象名詞是看不見的概念、情緒或狀態（love, time, freedom）。

uses.t: 可數 & 不可數名詞 Countable & Uncountable
uses.d: 可數名詞有單複數：單數可數名詞前一定要有限定詞（a/an/the/this/my/one…）。不可數名詞沒有複數、要用單數動詞，不能加 a/an，要數就用「量詞」。

ex.s: Can I have some water? ✗ a water
ex.n: 不可數：用 some，不用 a/an

ex.s: She gave me a piece of advice.
ex.n: 要數不可數名詞 → 用量詞

uses.t: 物質名詞 & 集合名詞 Material & Collective
uses.d: 物質名詞（water, gold, rice）通常不可數、用單數動詞、不加 a/an 或數字。集合名詞（team, family, police）當「整體」看用單數動詞，當「一群個體」看用複數動詞。

ex.n: 物質名詞 → 單數動詞 is

uses.d: 兩個或以上的字組成一個名詞，有三種寫法：相連、空格、連字號。
名詞或名詞片語可以當主詞、受詞、補語或同位語。

ex.n: 主詞 Nicole · 受詞 dolls

mistakes.why: 單數可數名詞前一定要有限定詞——台灣學生最常漏掉的 a。
country 是單數可數名詞，前面要有 a。
advice 是不可數名詞，沒有複數、不加 -s。
語言是專有名詞，第一個字母要大寫。

tip: 三個關鍵：① 單數可數名詞前一定要有限定詞（a/an/the/this/my/one…）；② 不可數名詞沒有複數、用單數動詞，要數就用量詞（a piece of…）；③ 人名、地名、語言、星期、月份都大寫。

q.q: Which word is a proper noun?
q.why: 星期 Monday 是專有名詞，要大寫。
單數可數名詞 doctor 前要有限定詞 a。
water 不可數，用 some，不用 a/an。
advice 不可數，沒有複數形。

q.q: My family ___ going to Japan together.
q.why: 把 family 當整體看，用單數動詞 is。

q.q: Which one is a compound noun?
q.why: sun + light 相連成一個複合名詞。
語言是專有名詞，要大寫 English。

q.q: An elephant is ___ very big animal.
q.why: 單數可數名詞前要有限定詞 a。
地名是專有名詞，要大寫 Taiwan。

q.sent: The police are very busy today
q.why: police 是集合名詞、視為複數，用 are。

title: Verbs
sub: 表動作或狀態的字：行為／連綴動詞、及物／不及物、助動詞與情態助動詞，以及時式、主詞動詞一致與語態。

form.p: A verb shows an action or a state.　主詞 + 動詞 (+ 受詞／補語)
ex: State 狀態: be, have, know, like
Linking 連綴: be, become, seem, look, taste
Helping 助動詞: do, have, will, can

uses.t: 行為動詞 & 連綴動詞 Action & Linking
uses.d: 行為動詞表「做」某動作；連綴動詞（be, become, seem, look, feel, taste, smell, sound）把主詞和後面的補語（形容詞或名詞）連起來。

uses.t: 及物 & 不及物動詞 Transitive & Intransitive
uses.d: 及物動詞後面要接受詞；不及物動詞後面不接受詞。有些動詞兩者都可以。

uses.t: 助動詞 & 情態助動詞 Auxiliary & Modal
uses.d: 助動詞（be, do, have）幫忙組時態、問句、否定；情態助動詞（can, will, must, should, may）加語氣，後面一定接原形動詞。

uses.t: 主詞-動詞一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
uses.d: 現在簡單式，主詞是第三人稱單數（he/she/it）時，動詞要加 -s/-es；其他人稱用原形。

uses.t: 動詞變化與時式 Forms & Tense
uses.d: 一個動詞有原形、第三人稱 -s、-ing、過去式、過去分詞；時式表達時間（過去、現在、未來）。

ex.s: 過去式與過去分詞 → 到動詞三態專區

uses.t: 主動 & 被動語態 Active & Passive
uses.d: 主動：主詞做動作；被動：主詞承受動作，用 be + 過去分詞。

mistakes.no: He go to school every day.
mistakes.yes: He goes to school every day.
mistakes.why: 第三人稱單數 he，動詞要加 -es → goes。
he/she/it 的否定用 doesn't。
agree 本身是動詞，前面不加 be。

mistakes.no: The window broke by the storm.
mistakes.yes: The window was broken by the storm.
mistakes.why: 被動語態要用 be + 過去分詞 was broken。

tip: 三個重點：① 第三人稱單數現在式動詞加 -s/-es；② 情態助動詞（can/will/must…）後接原形動詞；③ 被動語態＝be＋過去分詞。

q.why: 主詞 brother（第三人稱單數）→ lives。
she 的否定用 doesn't + 原形。
連綴動詞 taste + 形容詞 delicious。
情態助動詞 must 後接原形 go。

q.q: The window ___ by the storm last night.
q.why: 被動語態 be + 過去分詞 → was broken。
sleep 是不及物動詞，後面不接受詞。
sister 是第三人稱單數，否定用 doesn't。

q.sent: The letter was written by Tom
q.why: 被動語態 be + 過去分詞 + by + 行為者。

title: Adjectives & Adverbs
sub: 形容詞修飾名詞、副詞修飾動詞／形容詞／全句：位置、順序、-ly 規則與例外，以及最易混的形容詞 vs 副詞。

form.p: Adjective 修飾名詞；Adverb 修飾動詞、形容詞、其他副詞或全句。

uses.d: 形容詞修飾名詞或代名詞，有兩個位置：限定用法（放名詞前）、敘述用法（放連綴動詞後）。

ex.n: 連綴動詞 look + 形容詞

uses.t: 形容詞的順序 Order of Adjectives
uses.d: 多個形容詞的順序：意見 → 大小 → 新舊 → 形狀 → 顏色 → 來源 → 材料 → 名詞。

ex.s: ✗ a black small table → ✓ a small black table

uses.t: 副詞修飾動詞／形容詞／全句 Adverbs
uses.d: 副詞可以修飾動詞、形容詞、另一個副詞，或整個句子。

uses.t: 副詞的種類 Kinds of Adverbs
uses.d: 常見五類：方式、時間、地點、頻率、程度。

ex.s: 方式: carefully · 時間: today · 地點: here

uses.t: 形容詞變副詞 -ly 與例外
uses.d: 多數副詞＝形容詞＋-ly；但有同形字、不規則字，也有 -ly 結尾卻是形容詞的字。

ex.s: quick → quickly, happy → happily, true → truly
good → well（不規則）· friendly, lovely 是形容詞

uses.t: 形容詞 vs 副詞（最易混）
uses.d: 修飾名詞用形容詞；修飾動詞用副詞。但連綴動詞（be, look, taste, smell）後面接形容詞。

mistakes.why: 修飾動詞 sing 要用副詞 beautifully。
修飾動詞 run 要用副詞 quickly。

mistakes.no: I bought a black small table.
mistakes.yes: I bought a small black table.
mistakes.why: 形容詞順序：大小在顏色前面。
連綴動詞 taste 後面接形容詞 good，不是副詞。

tip: 修飾名詞用形容詞、修飾動詞用副詞；多數副詞＝形容詞＋ly（good→well 例外）；連綴動詞（be, look, taste, smell）後面接形容詞不是副詞。

q.why: 修飾名詞 singer → 形容詞 beautiful。
修飾動詞 sing → 副詞 beautifully。
順序：意見 nice → 顏色 black → 材料 leather。
連綴動詞 smell 後接形容詞 sweet。
修飾動詞 speak，good 的副詞是 well。
fast 的副詞同形，就是 fast。
修飾動詞 listen → 副詞 carefully。
friendly 雖以 -ly 結尾，卻是形容詞，修飾 person。

q.sent: He finished the test very quick .
q.why: 修飾動詞 finish → 副詞 quickly。
順序：大小 → 形狀 → 材料 → 名詞。

title: The Verb Be
sub: am / is / are（現在）與 was / were（過去）：描述人事物、說明身份與狀態、表示位置，以及否定與問句。

form.p: 主詞 + be (am/is/are) + 補語（名詞／形容詞／地點）

uses.t: be + 名詞／形容詞（身份、狀態）
uses.d: be 動詞連接主詞和後面的名詞或形容詞，說明主詞「是什麼」或「怎麼樣」。
be 動詞後接地點，表示人或物「在哪裡」。

uses.t: 主詞與 be 的搭配
uses.d: I → am；he/she/it 和單數名詞 → is；you/we/they 和複數名詞 → are。
否定：be + not（isn't / aren't / wasn't）。問句：把 be 移到主詞前面。
現在的 am/is → was；are → were。

mistakes.why: 主詞 I 要配 am。
she（第三人稱單數）要配 is。

mistakes.yes: He is not here. / He isn't here.
mistakes.why: be 動詞的否定是 be + not，不是 no。
be 動詞問句把 be 移到主詞前面。

tip: 主詞配對：I→am；he/she/it／單數→is；you/we/they／複數→are。否定加 not，問句把 be 移到句首。過去式：was（I/he/she/it）、were（you/we/they）。

q.why: brother 第三人稱單數 → is。
問句 be 移到句首，you → Are。

q.q: We ___ (be, 現在) very happy today.
He ___ (be, 否定·現在) a doctor.

q.why: parents 複數主詞要配 are。
be 動詞問句：be + 主詞 + …？

title: Subject & Object Pronouns
sub: 主格（I, he, she… 當主詞）與受格（me, him, her… 當受詞或介系詞後），用代名詞取代名詞、避免重複。

form.p: 主格當主詞（動詞前）；受格當受詞（動詞或介系詞後）
ex: 主格: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
受格: me, you, him, her, it, us, them

uses.d: 放在動詞前面、當句子的主詞：I, you, he, she, it, we, they。
放在動詞或介系詞後面：me, you, him, her, it, us, them。
每個主格都有對應的受格，要一起記。
it 除了代替東西、動物，還能當「虛主詞」說天氣、時間、距離。
「某人和我」當主詞用 …and I；當受詞用 …and me。拿掉另一個人就知道該用哪個。

mistakes.why: 當主詞要用主格 she。
當動詞的受詞要用受格 her。
當主詞要用主格 He and I。

mistakes.no: This is for you and I.
mistakes.yes: This is for you and me.
mistakes.why: 介系詞 for 後面用受格 me。

tip: 動詞前用主格、動詞／介系詞後用受格；「某人和我」當主詞用 …and I、當受詞用 …and me（把另一個人拿掉就看得出來）。

q.why: 動詞 help 的受詞用受格 me。
介系詞 to 後用受格 us。
當主詞用主格 She（She and I）。

q.q: I like this song. Play ___ (it 的受格) again.
The gift is from my parents and ___ (I 的受格).

q.why: 主格 She 當主詞、受格 it/me 當受詞與介系詞後。

title: Present Simple
sub: 現在簡單式：習慣、一般事實、時間表。第三人稱單數動詞加 -s/-es；否定與問句用 do/does。

tl.cap: Repeated actions across time — every day, every week, always.

form.p: 主詞 + 原形動詞（he/she/it + 動詞-s）
ex: 否定: don't / doesn't + 原形
問句: Do / Does + 主詞 + 原形?

uses.d: 常用 every day, usually, on Mondays 等。
不變的事實、科學道理。
班次、節目、課表。
he/she/it 動詞要變化。
用 do/does + 原形（主動詞回原形）。

mistakes.why: 第三人稱單數 he，動詞加 -s → plays。
he/she/it 的否定用 doesn't。
問句有 does 了，主動詞回原形 like。

mistakes.no: I am go to school every day.
mistakes.yes: I go to school every day.
mistakes.why: 一般動詞句不加 be；要說進行才用 am going。

tip: he/she/it 動詞加 -s/-es；否定與問句用 do/does＋原形（do/does 已帶 s，主動詞回原形）。頻率副詞放一般動詞前、be 動詞後。

q.why: father（第三人稱單數）問句用 Does。
一般事實、water 視為 it → boils。

q.sent: My brother go to school by bus .
q.why: brother 第三人稱單數，動詞加 -es → goes。
問句 Does + 主詞 + 原形。

title: Present Continuous
sub: 現在進行式 be + V-ing：此刻正在進行、最近一陣子、已安排的未來。注意 V-ing 拼字與狀態動詞。

tl.cap: An action in progress at this moment — it has started and hasn't finished.

form.p: 主詞 + be (am/is/are) + V-ing

uses.d: 常用 now, right now, at the moment, Look!

uses.t: 最近一段時間（未必此刻）
uses.d: 這陣子、最近的暫時狀態。

ex.s: These days I am studying for exams.
She is working in Taipei this month.

uses.d: 確定的計畫（常有時間）。
一般加 -ing；e 結尾去 e；短母音+單子音重複；-ie→ying。

uses.t: 狀態動詞通常不用進行式
uses.d: know, like, want, have(擁有), believe 等。

mistakes.why: be 後面要用 V-ing → cooking。

mistakes.yes: I am reading a book now.
mistakes.why: 進行式要有 be（am）+ V-ing。
短母音+單子音，n 要重複 → running。
know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式。

tip: be + V-ing 兩個都要有；拼字：短母音+單子音重複（run→running）、e 結尾去 e（make→making）；狀態動詞（know, like, want）通常不用進行式。

q.q: We ___ for the bus right now.

q.why: 狀態動詞 want 不用進行式。
進行式問句：Wh- + be + 主詞 + V-ing。

title: Adverbs of Frequency
sub: 頻率副詞 always / usually / often / sometimes / seldom / never：說明多常發生，以及在句中的位置。

form.p: 頻率副詞放「一般動詞前、be 動詞後、第一個助動詞後」

uses.d: always > usually > often > sometimes > seldom/rarely > never。
主詞 + 頻率副詞 + 一般動詞。
be 動詞句：be + 頻率副詞。
有助動詞時放其後。
never 本身是否定，不再加 not。

mistakes.no: I go always to school by bus.
mistakes.yes: I always go to school by bus.
mistakes.why: 頻率副詞放一般動詞 go 前面。
be 動詞句，頻率副詞放 be 後面。
never 已經是否定，不再加 don't。

tip: 頻率副詞放「一般動詞前、be 動詞後、第一個助動詞後」；sometimes、usually 也可放句首或句尾；never 已是否定，別再加 not。

q.why: 頻率副詞放一般動詞 drink 前。

q.q: We ___ go to the beach in summer.
q.why: 一般動詞 go 前放 often。
助動詞 can 後放 always。

q.sent: My dad always is tired after work .
q.why: be 動詞句，頻率副詞放 be 後：is always。

q.sent: I never drink coffee at night
q.why: never 放一般動詞 drink 前。

title: Be Verb: Past
sub: Be 動詞過去式 was / were：描述過去的身份、狀態、位置，以及過去的否定與問句、There was/were。

form.p: I / he / she / it + was　·　you / we / they + were
ex: 問句: Was / Were + 主詞?

uses.d: I/he/she/it/單數 → was；you/we/they/複數 → were。
說過去「是什麼、在哪裡」。
was/were + not。
把 was/were 移到主詞前。
說過去「有」某物。

ex.s: There was a cat in the box.

mistakes.why: they（複數）配 were。
I 配 was。
否定是 was + not（wasn't）。
they 問句用 Were。

tip: was（I/he/she/it／單數）、were（you/we/they／複數）；否定加 not（wasn't/weren't），問句把 was/were 移到句首。

q.q: They ___ very tired after the trip.
___ a big tree in the garden.
q.why: 單數 a tree → There was。

q.q: We ___ (be, 過去) in the same class.

q.why: There be 過去問句：Were there…？

title: Have & Have Got
sub: have 和 have got 都表「擁有」：兩種說法、否定與問句，以及第三人稱 has / has got。

form.p: I have = I've got　·　He has = He's got
ex: I have a bike. = I've got a bike.
She has blue eyes. = She's got blue eyes.
否定: don't have / haven't got
問句: Do you have…? / Have you got…?

uses.d: 意思相同；have got 較口語（英式常用）。

uses.t: 第三人稱 has / has got
uses.d: he/she/it 用 has。

ex.s: She has a dog. = She's got a dog.

uses.d: don't/doesn't have 或 haven't/hasn't got。
Do you have…? 或 Have you got…?

uses.t: 動作的 have 不能用 got
uses.d: have breakfast / a shower / a break 等是動作，不能換成 got。

mistakes.why: 第三人稱單數用 has。

mistakes.no: I have got not a pen.
mistakes.why: have got 的否定是 haven't got。

mistakes.no: Do you have got a minute?
mistakes.yes: Have you got a minute? / Do you have a minute?
mistakes.why: 兩套說法不能混用。
動作的 have（吃早餐）不能用 got。

tip: have got ＝ have（擁有）；第三人稱 has / has got；否定與問句兩套（Do you have…? 或 Have you got…?）不要混用；表「吃／洗／做」等動作的 have 不能用 got。

q.why: have got 的否定 → haven't got。
have 的問句用 Do you have…？
動作 have breakfast，不用 got。

q.q: They ___ (have got, 否定) a dog.

q.sent: My brother have got a bike .
q.why: 第三人稱單數 → has got。
have got 問句：Have + 主詞 + got…？

title: Their / There / They're
sub: their / there / they're 同音易混：their（他們的）、there（那裡／There is/are）、they're（they are）。

form.p: their = 所有格　·　there = 地點／There be　·　they're = they are

uses.d: 所有格，後面接名詞。
指地點。
表示「有」。

ex.s: There is a cat on the roof.

uses.d: 縮寫。
能還原成 they are → they're；指地點／存在 → there；表「他們的」+名詞 → their。

ex.s: They're (they are) late. · their bag · over there

mistakes.why: 能還原成 they are → they're。
指地點用 there。
表「他們的」+名詞用 their。
所有格用 their。

tip: they're＝they are（能還原就用它）；there 指地點或 There is/are；their＋名詞表「他們的」。

q.q: ___ is a park near my house.

q.why: 能還原成 they are → They're。
There are + 複數名詞（存在）。

title: Capitalization
sub: 大小寫規則：句首、代名詞 I、人名地名、語言國籍、星期月份、標題等要大寫。

form.p: 句子第一個字母、I、專有名詞 → 大寫

uses.d: 每個句子開頭大寫。

uses.t: 代名詞 I 永遠大寫
uses.d: 無論在句中哪裡。

uses.t: 專有名詞（人名、地名、國家）
uses.d: 特定的名稱。

uses.t: 語言、國籍、星期、月份、節日
uses.d: 這些都大寫。
主要字大寫（a, the, of 等小字通常不大寫，除非開頭）。

mistakes.why: 句首、I、地名 Taipei 都要大寫。
句首、語言 English、星期 Monday 大寫。
句首與國家 Japan 大寫。
句首與月份 December 大寫。

tip: 句首、代名詞 I、人名地名、語言國籍、星期月份、節日都大寫；一般名詞（dog, school）除非在句首或是專有名詞，否則小寫。

q.why: 星期 Monday 是專有名詞。
只有句首 My 大寫，dog 是普通名詞。
句首第一個字要大寫 We（English 也該大寫）。
I 與地名 New York 大寫。

title: Word Order
sub: 英文基本語序 S + V + O，以及形容詞、地點、時間、頻率副詞的位置。

form.p: 主詞 + 動詞 + 受詞 (+ 地點 + 時間)
ex: 形容詞放名詞前: a red car
頻率副詞放動詞前: I usually walk.

uses.d: 主詞 → 動詞 → 受詞。
地點 + 時間（不是倒過來）。

ex.s: I play soccer at the park on Sundays.

uses.d: 形容詞修飾名詞時放前面。
一般動詞前、be 動詞後。

uses.t: 問句與否定會調整語序
uses.d: 用助動詞 do/does/be 幫忙。

mistakes.why: 時間放句尾，不插在動詞和受詞中間。
受詞先、時間後。
受詞 pizza 放動詞後，very much 放句尾。
頻率副詞放 be 動詞後。

tip: 基本語序 S+V+O；地點在時間前（at home every day）；形容詞放名詞前；頻率副詞放一般動詞前、be 動詞後。

q.q: Which sentence has correct word order?
Put in order: play / I / tennis / on Sundays.
q.why: 受詞先、時間後：play tennis on Sundays。
冠詞 + 形容詞 + 名詞：a red car。
頻率副詞放一般動詞 goes 前。

q.q: Reorder: 'home / I / at / study'. → I study ___ ___.

q.sent: I like very much this song .
q.why: 受詞放動詞後、very much 放句尾：like this song very much。

zh: 句型一 S + V（主 + 不及物動詞）
title: Sentence Pattern 1: S + V
sub: 主詞 + 不及物動詞：動詞本身意思完整，後面不接受詞（可加時間、地點等修飾語）。

form.p: S + V（+ 修飾語）

uses.t: 動詞本身意思即完整（不需受詞）Verb is complete on its own
uses.d: 不及物動詞（intransitive verb）不需要接任何受詞，單靠「主詞 + 動詞」就能表達完整語意。

ex.n: 主詞 + 動詞 — 意思完整，不需受詞（她微笑了。）
加了副詞 quickly 修飾動作，依然沒有受詞（他跑得很快。）

uses.t: S + V + 地點 / 時間（可選補充修飾語）Optional extras
uses.d: 後面可以加上地點或時間等副詞片語，但這些只是「補充說明（修飾語）」，不是動詞的受詞。

ex.s: They arrived at school at 8 a.m.
ex.n: 先寫地點 at school，再寫時間 at 8 a.m.（他們早上八點到校。）
in Taipei 是介系詞片語表地點（他住在台北。）
on the sofa 表地點（她在沙發上睡著了。）

uses.t: 常見純不及物動詞 Common intransitive verbs
uses.d: 這些動詞絕對不能直接接受詞：go, come, arrive, sleep, fall, rise, run, smile, cry, happen。接地點時務必搭配介系詞！

mistakes.why: agree 是不及物動詞，接人要加介系詞 with。
listen 是不及物動詞，後面要加 to。
happen 是不及物動詞，沒有被動語態。

tip: 不及物動詞後面不直接接受詞；要接名詞常需介系詞（listen to, wait for, look at）。不及物動詞沒有被動語態。

q.why: rise 是不及物動詞：太陽升起。

q.q: We ___ at the station at noon.
q.why: arrive 不及物，不加受詞也不用被動。
wait 不及物，接人用 wait for。
look 不及物，接受詞用 look at。
S + V + 地點修飾語（不及物）。

zh: 句型二 S + V + C（主 + 連綴動詞 + 補語）
title: Sentence Pattern 2: S + V + C
sub: 主詞 + 連綴動詞 + 補語：補語（名詞或形容詞）補充說明主詞。be / become / seem / look / feel / taste…

form.p: S + V(連綴) + C（名詞／形容詞）

uses.t: be 動詞 + 名詞或形容詞 Be + noun / adjective
uses.d: 最基礎的連綴動詞是 be（am/is/are/was/were）。補語（Complement）用來說明主詞是「什麼身分」或處於「什麼狀態」。

ex.n: 名詞補語 a doctor 說明主詞身分：Tom = a doctor（湯姆是醫生。）
形容詞補語 cold 描述天氣狀態（天氣很冷。）

uses.t: 狀態改變與外觀連綴動詞 Become / seem / appear / remain
uses.d: 這些動詞連接主詞與後方的形容詞或名詞，用來描述主詞的「轉變、顯得或維持」的狀態。

ex.n: became 後接名詞補語（她成為了一位著名歌手。）
seem 後接形容詞補語 tired（他看起來很累。）
remained 後接形容詞補語（問題依然懸而未決。）

uses.t: 五大感官連綴動詞 Sense verbs: look / sound / feel / taste / smell
uses.d: 感官連綴動詞後面務必接「形容詞」而非副詞！因為它是用來修飾主詞的感受或特質。

ex.n: 用形容詞 delicious，不可用副詞 deliciously（蛋糕看起來很美味。）
用形容詞 beautiful（那音樂聽起來很美妙。）

mistakes.why: 連綴動詞後接形容詞（補語），不是副詞。
become 後面直接接補語，不加 to。
感官連綴動詞 smell 後接形容詞 bad。

tip: 連綴動詞後面接形容詞或名詞當補語（描述主詞），不是副詞。常見：be, become, get, seem, look, feel, taste, smell, sound。

q.why: 連綴動詞 smell + 形容詞 sweet。
連綴動詞 look + 形容詞 happy。
sound 是連綴動詞 + 形容詞 great。
get（變得）是連綴動詞 + 形容詞 cold。
taste 連綴動詞 + 形容詞 good。
seem 連綴動詞後用形容詞 tired。
S + 連綴動詞 + 形容詞補語。

zh: 句型三 S + V + O（主 + 及物動詞 + 受詞）
title: Sentence Pattern 3: S + V + O
sub: 主詞 + 及物動詞 + 受詞：及物動詞一定要有受詞（名詞、代名詞、動名詞或不定詞）。

form.p: S + V(及物) + O（名詞／代名詞／動名詞／不定詞）

uses.t: 及物動詞必須有受詞 Transitive verbs require an object
uses.d: 及物動詞（transitive verb）的動作會直接施加在對象上，在動詞後面問「什麼（what）？」或「誰（whom）？」所得到的答案就是受詞（Object）。

ex.n: 吃什麼？→ 早餐 breakfast（受詞）（她每天早上吃早餐。）
打電話給誰？→ 媽媽 his mother（受詞）（他打電話給他媽媽。）

uses.t: 否定句與疑問句結構 Negative and question forms
uses.d: 及物動詞造否定句或疑問句時，一般現在式用 do / does，過去式用 did，後面的及物動詞必須還原為「原形動詞」。

ex.n: 否定句：doesn't + 動詞原形 + 受詞（她不吃肉。）
疑問句：Do + 主詞 + 動詞原形 + 受詞？（你知道答案嗎？）

uses.t: 動名詞或不定詞當受詞 Gerund or infinitive as object
uses.d: 受詞不一定是名詞，也可以是動名詞（V-ing）或不定詞（to V）！這依然是標準的 S + V + O 句型。

ex.n: enjoy 後面必須接動名詞 V-ing 當受詞（我喜愛游泳。）
want 後面接不定詞 to V 當受詞（她想要離開。）

mistakes.why: 及物動詞 like 一定要有受詞。
enjoy 的受詞用動名詞 swimming。
discuss 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，不加 about。

tip: 及物動詞後面一定要有受詞；受詞可以是名詞、代名詞（用受格）、動名詞或不定詞——哪些動詞接動名詞、哪些接不定詞，到動名詞與不定詞那一課再細分。

q.why: 及物動詞 know 的受詞用受格 her。

q.q: I really like ___ (it 受格). （別漏受詞）
q.why: 及物動詞 like 要有受詞 it。

q.sent: We discussed about the new plan .

zh: 句型四 S + V + IO + DO（主 + 授與動詞 + 間接受詞 + 直接受詞）
title: Sentence Pattern 4: S + V + IO + DO
sub: 主詞 + 授與動詞 + 間接受詞(人) + 直接受詞(物)：give / send / show / tell / teach…，可改寫成 to / for 句型。

form.p: S + V + IO(人) + DO(物)　＝　S + V + DO + to/for + 人

uses.t: 授與動詞雙受詞 Ditransitive verbs: give / send / show / teach / tell
uses.d: 授與動詞表達把「事物（直接受詞 DO）」交給「某人（間接受詞 IO）」。正常語序是：先放「人（IO）」，再放「物（DO）」，此時中間不加任何介系詞！

ex.n: 人 us (IO) 在前，物 the photos (DO) 在後（她拿照片給我們看。）
人 the class，物 grammar（他教全班文法。）

uses.t: 改寫為 to 或 for 的句型 Rewrite with 'to' or 'for'
uses.d: 如果把「物（DO）」移到前面，「人（IO）」移到後面，人前面就必須加上介系詞 to（給/寄/教/借）或 for（買/做/煮）。

ex.s: She gave me a gift. → She gave a gift to me.
ex.n: give 搭配介系詞 to（她給了我一份禮物。）

ex.s: He bought her flowers. → He bought flowers for her.
ex.n: buy 搭配介系詞 for（他買花給她。）

ex.s: She made us dinner. → She made dinner for us.
ex.n: make 搭配介系詞 for（她為我們做晚餐。）

uses.t: 辨識要訣：間接受詞是「人」，直接受詞是「物」 IO = person, DO = thing
uses.d: 間接受詞（IO）永遠是承受好處的對象（人或群體），直接受詞（DO）則是實際轉移的物品或訊息。

ex.s: She told her friend [IO] a secret [DO].
ex.n: 人 her friend，物 a secret（她告訴朋友一個祕密。）

ex.s: He sent his parents [IO] a postcard [DO].
ex.n: 人 his parents，物 a postcard（他寄了明信片給父母。）

ex.s: The teacher gave the students [IO] a quiz [DO].
ex.n: 老師給學生做了一份小測驗。

mistakes.no: She gave to me a gift.
mistakes.yes: She gave me a gift. / She gave a gift to me.
mistakes.why: 雙受詞「人+物」中間不加 to；要用 to 就改成「物 + to + 人」。

mistakes.yes: He explained the rule to me.
mistakes.why: explain 不能用雙受詞，只能用 explain + 物 + to + 人。

mistakes.yes: I bought her flowers. / I bought flowers for her.
mistakes.why: buy 改寫用 for，且順序要正確。

tip: 雙受詞順序「人 + 物」，中間不加介系詞；改寫時 give/send/show/tell 用 to、buy/make/get/cook 用 for。explain/suggest/describe/introduce 不能用雙受詞，只能用「物 + to + 人」。

q.why: 雙受詞「人 + 物」：me a watch。

q.q: She sent a postcard ___ her friend.
Can you ___ the way to the station?
q.why: explain 不用雙受詞，用 explain (物) to me。
show + 人 + 物：showed me his phone。

q.sent: She gave to me a present .
q.why: 雙受詞「人+物」中間不加 to：gave me a present。
S + V + 間接受詞(人) + 直接受詞(物)。

zh: 句型五 S + V + O + OC（主 + 不完全及物動詞 + 受詞 + 受詞補語）
title: Sentence Pattern 5: S + V + O + OC
sub: 主詞 + 不完全及物動詞 + 受詞 + 受詞補語：補語（形容詞／名詞／原形／V-ing／V3）補充說明受詞。

form.p: S + V + O + OC（形容詞／名詞／原形動詞／V-ing／V3）

uses.t: 使役與狀態動詞 make / keep / find + 受詞 + 形容詞補語
uses.d: 這些動詞讓受詞處於某種狀態。後方的受詞補語（OC）是「形容詞」，用來補充說明「受詞」如何，而不是修飾動詞！

ex.n: healthy 是受詞 you 的補語：you are healthy（運動讓你保持健康。）
boring 說明電影無聊：the film was boring（她覺得這部電影很無聊。）

uses.t: 命名與任命動詞 call / name / elect / appoint + 受詞 + 名詞補語
uses.d: 這些動詞賦予受詞新的名稱、職稱或身分。受詞補語（OC）是「名詞」，與受詞劃上等號（O = OC）。

ex.n: 名詞補語 Max 說明狗的名字：the dog is Max（他們叫這隻狗 Max。）
名詞補語 president 是她的職銜（團隊選她為會長。）

uses.t: 感官動詞 see / hear / watch + 受詞 + 原形動詞 / V-ing
uses.d: 感官動詞的受詞補語可以用「原形動詞（看到/聽到整個完整動作）」或「V-ing（看到/聽到正在進行的動作）」。

ex.s: I saw him cross the road.
ex.n: 原形動詞 cross 表目睹穿越馬路的完整動作（我看見他穿過馬路。）
現在分詞 singing 表聽見歌聲正在唱（她聽見有人正在唱歌。）

mistakes.why: 受詞補語用形容詞 happy，不是副詞。
elect / name / call 後面接名詞補語，不加 as。

mistakes.no: I saw him to cross the street.
mistakes.yes: I saw him cross the street.
mistakes.why: 感官動詞 see 後接原形動詞（或 V-ing），不用 to。

tip: 受詞補語描述的是受詞：make/keep/find + 形容詞；call/name/elect + 名詞；see/hear/watch + 原形或 V-ing；使役 make/let/have + 原形。

q.why: 受詞補語用形容詞 sad。
name + 受詞 + 名詞補語，不加 as。
感官動詞 hear + 原形 call。
keep + 受詞 + 補語（過去分詞 closed，表被動狀態）。

q.q: My mom lets me ___ games on weekends.
q.why: 使役動詞 let + 原形 play。
keep + 受詞 + 形容詞補語 awake。
elect + 受詞 + 名詞補語，不加 as。
find + 受詞 + 形容詞補語。

title: Singular & Plural Nouns
sub: 名詞複數的規則變化（-s / -es / -ies / -ves）與不規則變化，以及單複數的動詞一致。

form.p: 單數 → 複數：大部分加 -s；特殊字尾另有規則；還有不規則複數

uses.d: 大多數名詞直接加 -s。
這些字尾加 -es；字尾 -o 有些也加 -es（tomato→tomatoes）。

ex.s: bus → buses, dish → dishes, box → boxes

uses.d: 子音+y 去 y 加 -ies；母音+y 直接加 -s。
許多 f/fe 結尾變 -ves。
要背的不規則；有些單複數一樣。

mistakes.why: child 的複數是不規則 children。
box 字尾 x，複數加 -es。
子音+y → 去 y 加 -ies。
leaf → leaves（f → ves）。

tip: 規則複數加 -s/-es/-ies/-ves；不規則要背（men, children, feet, teeth, mice）；有些單複數同形（fish, sheep, deer）。

q.q: The ___ are playing in the park.
My ___ hurt after the long walk.
There are five ___ on the farm.
We saw many ___ (leaf) on the ground.

title: This, That, These & Those
sub: this / that / these / those：近用 this/these、遠用 that/those；this/that 配單數、these/those 配複數。

form.p: 近：this（單）/ these（複）　·　遠：that（單）/ those（複）

uses.d: 近的用 this/these，遠的用 that/those。
this/that 配單數名詞；these/those 配複數名詞。
可單獨當代名詞，也可放名詞前當形容詞。
介紹、講電話的固定說法。

mistakes.why: books 是複數，要用 these。
單數 friend 用 that（Those 配複數）。
shoes 複數，用 those + are。

tip: this/these 指近、that/those 指遠；this/that 配單數、these/those 配複數。

q.q: ___ shoes are too small for me.

title: Articles: A, An, The
sub: a / an（第一次提到、泛指單數可數）、the（雙方都知道的特定）、零冠詞（複數與不可數的泛指）。

form.p: a/an + 單數可數（泛指）　·　the + 特定　·　複數／不可數泛指 → 不加冠詞
ex: the sun, the book you lent me（特定）

uses.t: a vs an（看發音，不是拼字）
uses.d: 下一個字發子音開頭用 a；發母音開頭用 an。看的是「聲音」。

uses.t: a / an：第一次提到、泛指、職業
uses.d: 用在「第一次出現」或「泛指一個」的單數可數名詞，也用在職業前。
用在雙方都清楚指哪一個、再次提到、或世上獨一無二的事物。

ex.s: I bought a book. The book is great.

uses.t: 零冠詞：複數與不可數的泛指
uses.d: 泛指「所有／一般」的複數名詞或不可數名詞，前面不加冠詞；某些片語（go to school/bed）也不加。

uses.t: a/an → the（先 a 後 the）
uses.d: 同一個東西第一次用 a/an，第二次雙方都知道了就用 the。

ex.s: I have a cat. The cat is black.

mistakes.why: 單數可數名詞前要有冠詞 a。
university 發 /j/ 子音，用 a。

mistakes.no: I go to the bed at ten.
mistakes.yes: I go to bed at ten.
mistakes.why: go to bed 是固定片語，不加 the。

mistakes.no: The water is important for life.
mistakes.why: 泛指不可數名詞不加 the。

tip: 第一次提到／泛指單數可數用 a/an（依發音選 a 或 an）；雙方都知道的特定用 the；複數或不可數的泛指不加冠詞。

q.q: I saw ___ owl in the tree.

q.why: engineer 母音開頭、職業 → an。
雙方都知道的特定 → the。
泛指複數不加冠詞 → Cats。
honest 的 h 不發音、母音開頭 → an。

q.q: I have a dog. ___ dog is very friendly.
q.why: 第二次提到、雙方都知道 → The。

q.sent: Water is important , so drink the water every day .
q.why: 泛指不可數「水」不加 the（第二個 water 應改寫為不加 the）。
apple 母音開頭、單數可數 → an。

zh: 可數與不可數 much / many
title: Much, Many & A Lot Of
sub: many（可數複數）、much（不可數）、a lot of（皆可）；以及 a few / a little 與 How many / How much。

form.p: many + 可數複數　·　much + 不可數　·　a lot of + 兩者皆可

uses.d: 用在可數名詞複數。
用在不可數名詞（常用於否定、問句）。

uses.t: a lot of / lots of（皆可）
uses.d: 可數、不可數都行，肯定句常用。

uses.t: a few（可數）/ a little（不可數）
uses.d: 表「一些」。few/little（無 a）帶否定意味「很少」。
問數量：可數用 How many、不可數用 How much。

mistakes.why: books 可數，用 many。
money 不可數，用 much。

mistakes.no: How much apples do you want?
mistakes.yes: How many apples do you want?
mistakes.why: apples 可數，用 How many。

tip: many 配可數複數、much 配不可數；a lot of 兩種都行；a few 配可數、a little 配不可數。

q.q: How ___ water do you drink a day?

q.why: a lot of 可數、不可數皆可。

q.q: How ___ books are on the shelf?

q.why: coffee（物質）不可數，用 much coffee（單數）。

q.sent: She has a few close friends

title: There Is / There Are
sub: There is / There are 表示「有」：單數與不可數用 There is、複數用 There are，動詞跟著後面第一個名詞。

form.p: There is + 單數／不可數　·　There are + 複數
ex: 否定: There isn't / aren't · 問句: Is / Are there…?

uses.d: 單數名詞或不可數名詞。

ex.s: There is a book on the desk.

uses.d: 複數名詞。
列舉時，be 跟最靠近的那個名詞。

ex.s: There is a pen and two books.
There are two books and a pen.

uses.d: 否定加 not；問句把 is/are 移到 there 前。
過去「有」。

ex.s: There was a party. / There were many guests.

mistakes.no: There are a cat on the roof.
mistakes.yes: There is a cat on the roof.
mistakes.why: a cat 單數 → There is。

mistakes.no: There is two dogs in the yard.
mistakes.yes: There are two dogs in the yard.
mistakes.why: two dogs 複數 → There are。
milk 不可數 → There is。

tip: There is + 單數／不可數、There are + 複數；列舉時動詞跟著後面第一個名詞；過去用 There was / were。

q.why: a problem 單數 → There is。
many people 複數 → There are。
juice 不可數、問句 → Is there。

q.q: There ___ a pen and three erasers on the desk.
q.why: 跟著第一個名詞 pen（單數）→ is。

q.q: ___ a big tree in the garden last year.
___ (There is/are) some bread on the table.

q.sent: There is five students in the room .
q.why: five students 複數 → There are。

title: Count & Non-count Nouns
sub: 可數名詞（有單複數、a/an、many）vs 不可數名詞（無複數、單數動詞、some/much、量詞）。

form.p: 可數：a/an、單複數、many　·　不可數：無複數、單數動詞、much、a __ of
ex: a glass of water, a piece of bread

uses.d: 能一個一個數，有單複數，可加 a/an、many、few。
不能數個數、沒有複數、用單數動詞，用 some/much/little。

uses.t: 要數不可數 → 用量詞
uses.d: 用容器、片塊、單位來數。

ex.s: a glass of water, a piece of bread

uses.d: 有些字兩種都行，意思不同。
容易記錯的不可數字。

ex.s: money, information, advice, furniture, homework, news

mistakes.yes: Can I have some water? / a glass of water?
mistakes.why: water 不可數，用 some 或量詞。
information 不可數，無複數、用 much。

mistakes.yes: I bought two loaves of bread.
mistakes.why: bread 不可數，要數用量詞。
furniture 不可數、單數動詞。

tip: 可數有單複數＋a/an＋many；不可數無複數＋單數動詞＋much；要數不可數就用「a __ of」。更多練習到可數不可數專區。

q.why: How many 配可數複數 → apples。

q.q: There ___ a lot of furniture in the room.

q.why: bread 不可數，用量詞 a slice of。

q.q: I need some ___ (information 的正確形式).

q.why: water 不可數，要數用量詞 glasses of water。

q.sent: I bought a piece of cheese
q.why: 不可數 cheese 用量詞 a piece of。

title: Possessives: my, mine & John's
sub: 所有格三種：所有格形容詞（my/your）、所有格代名詞（mine/yours）、名詞所有格（John's / the dogs'）。

form.p: my/your + 名詞　·　mine/yours（獨立）　·　名詞 + 's
ex: the dogs' toys（複數結尾 s 只加 ')

uses.t: 所有格形容詞 + 名詞
uses.d: my, your, his, her, its, our, their 後面接名詞。
mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs 後面不接名詞。
人或動物後加 's 表「的」。

uses.t: 複數／字尾 s 用 s'
uses.d: 複數結尾是 s，只加一撇；不規則複數仍加 's。
its 是所有格；it's 是 it is / it has。

mistakes.why: 名詞前用所有格形容詞 my。
獨立用所有格代名詞 mine。
children 是不規則複數，用 's。
所有格用 its（it's = it is）。

tip: my/your 當形容詞接名詞、mine/yours 獨立用；名詞加 's（複數結尾 s 只加 '）；its 是所有格、it's 是 it is。

q.why: 名詞 umbrella 前用 your。
獨立用所有格代名詞 mine。

q.q: The ___ toys are everywhere. (孩子們的)
q.why: 不規則複數 children 用 's。

q.q: These books are ___ (我們的, 獨立用).

q.sent: This bag is my , not yours .
q.why: 獨立用所有格代名詞 mine。
名詞所有格 sister's + 名詞。

title: Reflexive Pronouns
sub: myself, yourself, himself…：當主詞和受詞是同一人時使用，也可加強語氣或表「獨自」（by myself）。

form.p: 主詞 = 受詞 → 用反身代名詞

uses.d: 動作回到自己身上時用反身代名詞。
by oneself = 獨自、靠自己。
強調「親自、本人」。
每個人稱都有對應的反身代名詞。

uses.t: 不是每個動詞都要反身
uses.d: wash, dress, shave 等通常不用反身（除非強調）。

mistakes.no: I enjoyed me at the party.
mistakes.yes: I enjoyed myself at the party.
mistakes.why: 主詞=受詞，用 myself。
正確是 themselves（不是 theirselfs）。
正確是 himself（不是 hisself）。

tip: 主詞和受詞同一人用反身代名詞；by oneself = 獨自；正確形式是 himself / themselves（沒有 hisself / theirselves）。

q.q: She taught ___ to play the piano.
We really enjoyed ___ on the trip.
Be careful! Don't hurt ___ (you, 單數).

q.sent: He introduced hisself to the class .

q.why: 加強語氣的反身代名詞放句尾。

title: Indefinite Pronouns
sub: someone / anything / everybody / nothing…：some-/any-/every-/no- 搭配 -one/-body/-thing/-where，當單數。

form.p: some-/any-/every-/no- + -one/-body（人）/ -thing（物）/ -where（地點）

uses.t: some- 肯定、any- 否定與問句
uses.d: 肯定句用 some-，否定與問句用 any-。
字根決定指人、物還是地方。
不定代名詞當單數，動詞用單數。
no-/nothing 已含否定，不再加 not。

uses.t: some- 用在邀請／請求問句
uses.d: 提供、請求時問句仍可用 some-。

mistakes.yes: I don't have anything. / I have nothing.
mistakes.why: 否定句用 anything；或用 nothing（但不和 not 並用）。
不定代名詞當單數 → is。
有 does，動詞回原形 know。

mistakes.no: I saw anyone at the park.
mistakes.yes: I saw someone at the park.
mistakes.why: 肯定句用 someone。

tip: some- 用於肯定、any- 用於否定與問句；不定代名詞當單數（Everybody is…）；no-/nothing 已含否定，別再加 not。

q.q: I didn't tell ___ (任何人) your secret.

q.why: Nobody 已是否定、當單數：Nobody likes him。

q.sent: Someone is knocking on the door

zh: 量詞 a cup of / a piece of
title: Partitives
sub: a cup of, a piece of, a loaf of — how to count uncountable things.

form.p: a / an + unit + of + non-count noun

uses.d: Count liquids and food with a container: cup, glass, bottle, bowl.
Count food by its shape or a portion: piece, slice, loaf, bar.
Make the UNIT word plural (not the non-count noun).

mistakes.yes: I'd like a cup of tea, please.
mistakes.why: Tea is non-count — count it with 'a cup of'.

mistakes.yes: two loaves of bread / two pieces of bread
mistakes.why: Bread is non-count; count it with a unit word.
Make the unit plural (pieces), not the non-count noun.

tip: To count a non-count noun, add a unit: a + cup/piece/slice/bottle + of + noun. Make the UNIT plural (two cups of…), not the noun.

q.q: Can I have a ___ of water?

q.why: two slices of pizza (unit is plural).

q.q: Would you like a ___ of cake? (a portion)
She gave me a good piece ___ advice.

q.sent: I drank three cup of tea .
q.why: Make the unit plural: three cups of tea.

q.sent: He bought two bottle of milk .
q.why: Make the unit plural: two bottles of milk.

title: Wh- Questions
sub: Who, what, when, where, why, how — asking for real information.

form.p: Wh-word + do / does / did (or be) + subject + verb

uses.d: Each wh-word hunts for a different kind of answer.
For most verbs, a helper comes after the wh-word.

ex.n: did → verb goes back to base form

uses.t: How, alone or with a friend
uses.d: How pairs with adjectives for size, age, price and more.

mistakes.why: Wh-questions need do / does / did (or be).
After does, the verb goes back to base form.
Be moves before the subject.

tip: Question order is fixed: Wh-word → helper (do / does / did / be) → subject → verb.

q.why: The answer is a time → when.
The answer is a person → who.

q.q: ___ does this bag cost? — Five hundred dollars.

q.sent: What time does he goes to bed ?
q.why: Does already carries the -s — the verb stays base.

title: Imperatives
sub: Sit down. Don't worry. Let's go! — commands, instructions and invitations.

form.p: Base verb …   ·   Don't + base verb   ·   Let's + base verb

uses.d: Start with the verb — no subject needed. You is understood.
Don't + base verb tells someone what NOT to do.

uses.t: Let's for suggestions, please for politeness
uses.d: Let's includes yourself; please softens any command.

mistakes.why: Imperatives drop the subject you.
After don't, use the base verb — no to.
Let's + base form.

tip: Start with the verb. Negative? Just put Don't in front. Including yourself? Start with Let's.

q.why: Negative with an adjective → don't be.

q.q: Please ___ (turn) off your phone during the movie.

q.sent: Turns off the light when you leave .

zh: 連接詞 and / but / so / because
title: And, But, So & Because
sub: Four little words that join ideas — adding, contrasting, resulting and explaining.

form.p: idea 1 + and / but / so / because + idea 2
ex: He stayed home because he was sick.

uses.d: And joins similar ideas; but signals a surprise or opposite.
Cause first, then so, then what happened because of it.

ex.s: It was raining, so we took a taxi.
I forgot my wallet, so I couldn't pay.
The test is tomorrow, so let's review tonight.

uses.d: Because answers why — it introduces the cause.

ex.s: We stayed inside because it was too hot.
Because he practiced daily, he improved fast.

mistakes.no: I was hungry so because I ate.
mistakes.yes: I was hungry, so I ate.
mistakes.why: Pick one connector, not two.

mistakes.yes: I went to bed early because I was tired.
mistakes.why: Because needs a main sentence — it can't stand alone.

mistakes.no: He was sick, but he went to the doctor.
mistakes.yes: He was sick, so he went to the doctor.
mistakes.why: Seeing the doctor is the result of being sick → so.

tip: and = plus · but = opposite · so = result · because = reason.

q.q: I wanted to call you, ___ my phone died.
q.why: An obstacle — the opposite of the plan → but.

q.q: She was thirsty, ___ she drank some water.
We wear coats ___ it is cold.
q.why: The cold is the reason → because.

q.sent: I studied hard , because I passed the test .
I like tea but I don't like coffee
q.why: Contrast between the two likes → but.

opts: Because was raining, we stayed home.
We stayed home because it was raining.
We stayed home so because it was raining.
We stayed home because so it was raining.
q.why: Because + full clause, one connector only.

q.sent: The soup was hot , and I waited for it to cool .
q.why: Waiting is the result of the heat → so.

title: Prepositions: In, On, At
sub: The three little words for time and place — and how to pick the right one.

form.p: at + point   ·   on + surface / day   ·   in + space / period

uses.d: At for clock times, on for days and dates, in for longer periods.
At a point, on a surface, in an enclosed space.
Some combinations are fixed — learn them as chunks.

mistakes.why: Days take on.

mistakes.no: He gets up at the morning.
mistakes.yes: He gets up in the morning.
mistakes.why: Parts of the day take in — except at night.
Set phrase: at home.

tip: Zoom out: at a point (7:00, the door) → on a surface or day (Monday, the table) → in a big space or period (July, Taipei, the box).

q.q: The cat is sleeping ___ the sofa.

q.sent: We have English class in Tuesday .
The bank opens at nine in the morning
q.why: At + clock time, in + the morning.

q.sent: She studies at the library on the evening .
q.why: Parts of the day take in.

title: Yes / No Questions
sub: Questions answered with 'Yes' or 'No' — and how to build them.

form.p: Be / Do / Does / Can… + subject + …?

uses.t: With be — move be to the front
uses.d: Put am / is / are before the subject.

uses.t: With other verbs — use do / does
uses.d: Present simple: use do (I / you / we / they) or does (he / she / it) + the base verb.
Answer with the same helping verb — don't repeat the whole sentence.

ex.s: Do you like it? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

mistakes.why: With be, don't add do — just move be to the front.
After does, use the base verb (like).
Start present-simple questions with Do / Does.

tip: Be verb? → move it to the front. Any other verb? → start with Do / Does / Did + the base verb.

q.why: like is an ordinary verb → Do you like…?
he + ordinary verb → Does he speak…?

q.q: ___ they at the party last night? (be)
Best short answer to 'Can you swim?'
q.why: Answer with the same helping verb: Yes, I can.
have is an ordinary verb → Do you have a car?

title: Wh- Questions (Past)
sub: Asking who, what, where, when and why about the past — with did.

form.p: Wh- + did + subject + base verb …?

uses.d: For most past questions, use did + the base verb (not the past form).
If the verb is was / were, don't use did. Put was / were after the Wh- word.

uses.t: Who as the subject — no did
uses.d: When Who or What asks about the doer (the subject), use the past verb directly.

mistakes.why: Order: Wh- + did + subject + base verb.
After did, use the base verb (go), not went.
With were, put it before the subject; no did.

tip: Most past questions: Wh- + DID + subject + base verb. But with was / were, skip did. And when Who is the doer, use the past verb directly.

q.why: past question → What did you do…?
be verb → Where were you born? (you → were)

q.q: Who ___ the cake? (eat, past — Who = subject)
q.hint: no did; use the past verb
q.why: Who is the subject → ate (no did).
How was the weather? (asking about its condition)

q.sent: What time did you woke up ?

title: Tag Questions
sub: The little checking question at the end: '…, isn't it?'

form.p: positive sentence + negative tag? · negative sentence + positive tag?

uses.d: If the sentence is positive, the tag is negative. Use the same helping verb.
If the sentence is negative, the tag is positive.
Use be, or the helper (do / does / did, can, will…), and match the pronoun to the subject.

mistakes.why: Match the verb: are → aren't; you → you.
The subject is she, so the tag pronoun is she.
Positive sentence → negative tag.

tip: Positive sentence → negative tag, and the reverse. Use the same helping verb, and match the pronoun (Mary → she).

q.why: Negative sentence → positive tag: is she.

zh: 時間介系詞 at / in / on
title: Time: At, In, On
sub: Choosing at, in or on for clock times, days and months.

form.p: at + time · on + day/date · in + month/year/part of day

uses.d: Use at for exact times and a few fixed phrases.
Use on for days of the week and specific dates.
Use in for months, seasons, years and parts of the day.

mistakes.why: Days of the week take on.
Months take in.

mistakes.no: I get up at the morning.
mistakes.yes: I get up in the morning.
mistakes.why: Parts of the day take in (but note: at night).

tip: at = a point (a clock time). on = a day or date. in = a longer box of time (month, year, season). Watch out: at night.

q.q: The cat sleeps a lot ___ night.

title: Place & Movement
sub: Prepositions for where things are (in, on, under) and where they go (to, into, across).

form.p: place: in / on / under / between · movement: to / into / out of / across

uses.d: in (inside), on (a surface), under, next to, between, behind, in front of.

ex.s: The lamp is between the two beds.

uses.d: to (a destination), into / out of, up / down, across, through, along.
Use in/on for position; into/onto for movement to that position.

mistakes.why: For movement inside, use into.
arrive IN a city (not 'arrive to').

mistakes.no: The bird flew threw the window.
mistakes.yes: The bird flew through the window.
mistakes.why: through (movement), not 'threw' (past of throw).

tip: Position → in / on / under / between. Movement → to / into / out of / across / through. Note: arrive in a place, not 'arrive to'.

q.why: position (where it is) → under the table.

q.q: We walked ___ the bridge to the other side.
q.why: movement to the other side → across.

q.q: The cat is hiding ___ the bed. (position, underneath)

q.sent: He put the book on the shelf
They went in the cave to explore .

q.why: arrive IN a city → arrived in Tokyo.

q.sent: The dog jumped in the sofa .
q.why: movement onto a surface → onto the sofa.

title: Questions: Present Continuous
sub: Asking what is happening right now — Are you…? What are you doing?

form.p: (Wh-) + am / is / are + subject + V-ing?

uses.t: Yes/No questions — move be to the front
uses.d: Put am / is / are before the subject; keep the -ing verb.

uses.t: Wh- questions — Wh + be + subject + V-ing
uses.d: Start with the question word, then be, then the subject and -ing verb.
Answer with be — don't repeat the -ing verb.

ex.s: Are you studying? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

mistakes.why: Present continuous questions use be (are), not do.
Order: Wh- + be + subject + V-ing.
Keep the -ing form: playing.

tip: Present continuous question = (Wh-) + am/is/are + subject + verb-ing. Use be, not do. Keep the -ing.

q.q: Best short answer to 'Is it raining?'
q.why: Answer with be: Yes, it is.

q.sent: What is he do right now ?

title: Can & Could
sub: Ability, permission and polite requests — can, can't, could and couldn't.

form.p: subject + can / could + base verb

uses.d: Use can for present ability, could for past ability. Always + the base verb.

ex.s: He could read at the age of four.

uses.d: Ask permission with Can I / Could I. Could is a little more polite.
Ask someone to do something with Can you / Could you. Could you is politer.

mistakes.why: After can, use the base verb — no 'to'.
can never adds -s; it's the same for everyone.
After could, use the base verb (speak).

tip: can / could + base verb (no 'to', no -s). can = now, could = past ability or a politer version. Could you…? is the polite request.

q.q: When I was young, I ___ run very fast.
Which is the most polite request?
opts: Can you give me a pen?
Could you give me a pen, please?
q.why: Could you… please? is the politest.

q.q: She ___ swim, so she stays near the shore. (negative ability)

q.why: Can + I + base verb for permission.

q.sent: He can to drive a car .
q.why: After can, use the base verb — no 'to'.

q.sent: My sister cans speak English well .

title: Should & Ought To
sub: Giving advice — what is a good idea to do.

form.p: subject + should / ought to + base verb

uses.d: Use should + base verb to say what is a good idea. shouldn't for a bad idea.
ought to means the same as should. Note the 'to' before the verb.
Ask 'Should I…?' to get advice.

mistakes.why: should + base verb — no 'to'.
ought needs 'to': ought to sleep.
should never takes -s.

tip: should + base verb (no 'to'). ought TO + base verb (with 'to'). Both give advice. Question: Should I…?

q.q: You look tired. You ___ go to bed.
It's raining. We ___ take an umbrella.
You ___ smoke — it's bad for you. (negative advice)

q.why: What should I do? asks for advice.

title: Must & Have To
sub: Rules and necessity — and what you don't need to do.

form.p: subject + must / have to + base verb

uses.t: must — a strong rule or a personal need
uses.d: Use must + base verb for strong rules and things you feel are necessary.

ex.s: You must stop at a red light.

uses.d: have to means the same as must. Use has to for he / she / it; had to in the past.

uses.t: don't have to = it is NOT necessary
uses.d: 'don't have to' means there is no need — different from mustn't (not allowed).

ex.s: You don't have to come — it's optional.

mistakes.why: must + base verb — no 'to'.
he / she / it → has to.
For 'no need', use don't have to (not don't must).

tip: must + base verb (no 'to'). have to / has to = necessity. Careful: mustn't = NOT allowed, but don't have to = NO need — very different!

q.q: Students ___ wear a uniform. It's a school rule.
My mother is a nurse, so she ___ work at night sometimes.
Tomorrow is a holiday, so we ___ go to school.
Yesterday I ___ to wait a long time. (past of have to)

q.sent: You must not touch the paintings
She have to finish her homework .

title: May & Might
sub: Saying something is possible — and asking politely for permission.

form.p: subject + may / might + base verb

uses.d: Use may or might + base verb to say something is possible (you're not sure).

ex.s: I might not go to the party.

uses.d: May I…? is a polite (slightly formal) way to ask permission.
Just may / might + the base verb.

mistakes.why: might + base verb — no 'to'.
may never takes -s.
After might, use the base verb (come).

tip: may / might + base verb = perhaps / possibly. May I…? is polite permission. No -s, no 'to'.

q.q: Take a coat — it ___ get cold later.
I'm not sure. I ___ not go. (possibility)
'It ___ be true, but I'm not sure.'

title: Would Like
sub: A polite way to say what you want — and to offer and invite.

form.p: subject + would like + noun / to + base verb

uses.d: Use would like ('d like) instead of want to be polite. + a noun, or + to + verb.

ex.s: I'd like a glass of water.
I'd like to book a table.
She'd like to learn the guitar.

uses.d: Offer with Would you like + noun; invite with Would you like to + verb.
Answer offers with 'Yes, please.' or 'No, thank you.'

ex.s: Would you like more? — No, thank you.

mistakes.why: 'I would like…' is a statement — no question mark.

mistakes.yes: I would like to go home.
mistakes.why: Before a verb, use 'to': would like to go.

mistakes.no: Do you would like some tea?
mistakes.why: Start the question with Would (no 'do').

tip: would like = a polite 'want'. + a noun, or + TO + verb. Offer with 'Would you like…?' Answer: 'Yes, please.' / 'No, thank you.'

q.q: I'd like ___ a table for two, please.
Polite answer to 'Would you like more cake?'
q.why: Offers are answered with 'No, thank you.'

q.q: She ___ like to visit Japan one day. (short form of would after 'She')

q.sent: I would like to order now

q.why: Before a verb, use 'to': like to drink.

q.sent: Do you would like some help ?

title: Should Have
sub: Looking back — the right thing to do, but it didn't happen.

form.p: subject + should have + past participle (V3)

uses.t: should have + V3 — a past regret
uses.d: Use should have + the past participle to say the right thing to do in the past — but you didn't.

ex.n: a good idea, but you didn't

uses.d: Use shouldn't have + V3 for something you did that was a bad idea.
In speaking, should have is often said 'should've'. Never write 'should of'!

mistakes.why: It's should HAVE, never 'should of' — they just sound alike.
Use the past participle: gone (not went).
After should have, use the past participle (studied).

tip: should have + V3 (past participle) = the right thing in the past, but it didn't happen. In speech: 'should've' — never 'should of'.

q.q: I failed the test. I ___ harder.
I'm so full. I ___ have eaten so much. (negative)
q.why: shouldn't have eaten = it was a mistake.
the past participle of go is gone.

q.q: 'I should have brought an umbrella' means…
opts: I didn't bring one, and I regret it.
q.why: should have = didn't do it, now regret.

title: Participle Adjectives: -ed vs -ing
sub: bored or boring? The -ed feeling vs the -ing cause.

form.p: -ed = how someone feels · -ing = what causes the feeling

uses.d: Use the -ed adjective to describe how someone feels.
Use the -ing adjective for the thing that causes the feeling.
A person is -ed BY something -ing.

mistakes.why: To say how YOU feel, use -ed: bored. (I am boring = I make others bored!)
The movie causes the feeling → -ing: boring.
How she feels → -ed: interested.

tip: -ed = the feeling (I'm bored). -ing = the cause (it's boring). If a person feels it, use -ed; if a thing causes it, use -ing.

q.why: the trip causes the feeling → tiring (-ing).

q.q: After the long trip, I was very ___ .
This book is really ___ . I can't stop reading! (-ing)
The children were ___ by the magic show. (-ed, feeling)

q.sent: I was very boring during the meeting .

q.why: The news causes the feeling → shocking (-ing).

title: Collocations: Have, Take, Get
sub: Words that naturally go together — have a shower, take a break, get better.

form.p: learn these as whole phrases

uses.d: 'have' goes with meals, some activities and experiences.

ex.s: have a shower / a rest / a good time

uses.d: 'take' goes with these common actions.

ex.s: take a photo / a break / a taxi

uses.d: 'get' often means become, receive, or arrive.

mistakes.why: Meals go with 'have': have breakfast.
The natural pair is take a photo.
The natural pair is have a shower.

tip: Learn these as fixed pairs: have (meals, a shower, a rest), take (a photo, a break, a taxi, medicine), get (ready, better, home).

q.why: the natural pair is take a break.

q.q: Can you ___ a photo of us? (the natural verb)
I need to ___ a shower before we go. (the natural verb)

q.sent: Please make a taxi to the airport .
q.why: the natural pair is take a taxi.

q.sent: I take breakfast at eight every day .

zh: 運動與活動 do / go / play
title: Do, Go & Play (Activities)
sub: Which verb for which activity — play tennis, go swimming, do yoga.

form.p: play + ball games · go + -ing activities · do + other exercise

uses.d: Use 'play' for sports with a ball or a game/opponent.
Use 'go' + the -ing form for many activities (often outdoors).
Use 'do' for exercise without a ball, and some tasks.

mistakes.why: Activities ending in -ing take 'go': go swimming.
Ball games take 'play': play tennis.
Exercise without a ball takes 'do': do yoga.

tip: play + ball games & instruments (play tennis, play the piano). go + -ing activities (go swimming). do + exercise/tasks (do yoga, do homework).

q.q: Let's ___ shopping this weekend. (the right verb)
He can ___ the piano beautifully. (the right verb)

q.sent: They play running in the park .
I go karate twice a week .
q.why: exercise without a ball → do karate.
